title: On Ensuring that Intelligent Machines Are Well-Behaved
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The focus is on a general framework for creating 'well-behaved' machine learning algorithms, with examples primarily centered on avoiding sexism, racism, and physical harm.
